sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Catoscopium nigritum is a moss forming small, firm cushions, dark green to almost black, in open, wet, base-rich places such as coastal dune slacks, seepages and calcareous rock. Its leaves are less than 2 mm long.

sections.title: Capsule and plate
sections.text: The nearly spherical black capsule, about 1 mm long, is carried on a red seta up to 1 cm long; it is often inclined or horizontal. The plate's tiny hammer-like silhouette fits the moss. Like other mosses, it has no flowers or edible fruits.
